title: Concept: URLSession request target uses plaintext HTTP in swift — review required
description: In swift, a request targets http. TLS is what authenticates the server; without it an on-path attacker reads the request and can answer with their own content. iOS blocks this by default, so the presence of the literal also implies an ATS exception or a disabled policy.
applicability: swift iOS applications that call backend services.
risk: Request and response disclosure in transit; MEDIUM severity.
